system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template that provisions an S3 bucket suitable for hosting application user uploads with appropriate access controls.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template that provisions an S3 bucket suitable for hosting application user uploads with appropriate access controls.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Template for S3 bucket to host application user uploads

Resources:
  UserUploadsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'user-uploads-${AWS::AccountId}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  UserUploadsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref UserUploadsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowGetAndPutFromSpecificIP
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${UserUploadsBucket}/uploads/*'
            Condition:
              IpAddress:
                aws:SourceIp: !Sub '192.0.2.0/24' # restrict access to specific IP range

  UserUploadsBucketCorsConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DependsOn: UserUploadsBucket
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref UserUploadsBucket
      CorsConfiguration:
        CorsRules:
          - AllowedHeaders:
              - '*'
            AllowedMethods:
              - GET
              - PUT
              - POST
              - DELETE
            AllowedOrigins:
              - '*'
            ExposeHeaders:
              - ETag
              - x-amz-request-id
              - x-amz-id-2
            MaxAge: 3600

Outputs:
  UserUploadsBucketName:
    Value: !Ref UserUploadsBucket
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket for user uploads
  UserUploadsBucketArn:
    Value: !GetAtt UserUploadsBucket.Arn
    Description: ARN of the S3 bucket for user uploads
